title: devices.json hosts
description: The hosts the person is the assignee or the credential holder of (docs/spec/24-terminal.md); a host the person only created is not listed, because its name and times describe the person it is assigned to. No keys, fingerprints, pairing codes or reported session users.

platform.description: Operating system family of the host.

assignee.description: Whether the person is the host assignee.

creator.description: Whether the person also created the host.

credential_holder.description: Whether the person holds the LLM login of the host.

last_seen_at.description: When the host was last connected.
